## Independent replay

`src/uc_verify/replay.py` shares no code with `uc_core`. It regenerated all 161,000 records from their stream coordinates, refitted every series, redrew every surrogate and recomputed every summary. Agreement: **no**.

- Largest white-noise coefficient difference: 9.99e-16; classification mismatches: 0.
- Largest simulated-input difference: 3.55e-15; observed S: 8.19e-16; surrogate S: 3.64e-14.
- p-value mismatches: 0; surrogate status mismatches: 1; generator-state mismatches: 0; near ties within 1e-9: 1.
- Summary differences: 0; problems: 1.

AT-5, AT-15 and AT-16 assess this registered synthetic design only; passing does not establish universal calibration. D80 is a Monte Carlo point diagnostic, not a confidence bound.
